gnn_interpretation.interpretation: MODERATE / EXPLORATORY PASS; same physical candidate region, not strong residue-level reproducibility.

positive_control.role: AOH1996-derivative-bound reference, ligand stripped for protein-only MD
positive_control.expectation: control-first validation must be trajectory-derived: complete independent control replicates must remain artifact-free, open-like under the frozen thresholds, and show non-trivial local fluctuation. Static 8GLA-vs-1W60 starting-state separation is descriptive only and cannot pass the gate.

atom_selections.alignment: protein CA excluding the supported_ge2of3 pocket residues
atom_selections.primary_pocket: chain index 0 residues in core_3of3 and supported_ge2of3
atom_selections.exploratory_union: core + supported fringe + 1-of-3 seed-specific fringe; never primary by itself
atom_selections.sasa: protein context, Shrake-Rupley, atom-key parity enforced across apo/control before comparison

metrics.rmsd: backbone/CA RMSD after PBC imaging and alignment; stability descriptor only
metrics.rmsf: per-residue fluctuation after alignment, summarized by core/support/fringe; no pseudoreplication across frames
metrics.sasa: sum residue SASA for each predefined region, measured over identical atom keys across systems
metrics.dccm: CA dynamic cross-correlation after alignment; qualitative/supportive unless replicate-stable

openness.formula: open_like_frame if supported-region SASA and supported-region CA convex-hull volume both exceed reference midpoint thresholds; core SASA is reported as the primary localization check
openness.thresholds_source: prepared 1W60 and ligand-stripped prepared 8GLA static references before candidate production

pocket_volume.metric: CA convex hull volume of the predefined region
pocket_volume.status: adopted as a geometric descriptor, not a ligand-volume estimate; validated only as static reference discriminator before production

opening_event.localization_rule: core_sasa_A2 must be reported; events dominated only by seed-specific fringe are exploratory, not primary support

control_interpretability_gate.name: trajectory_dynamic_control_gate_v2
control_interpretability_gate.supersede_reason: v1 accepted three STATIC 8GLA structures plus ~0.10 A independent per-frame coordinate jitter as a PASS. 8GLA's frozen static reference already exceeds both midpoint openness thresholds (SASA 839.109 >= 808.568 A^2; CA hull 610.253 >= 560.687 A^3), so a motionless 8GLA run scores open_like_fraction = 1.0 from frame zero; and IID jitter of 0.10 A/axis produces RMSF 0.0174 nm, clearing the 0.015 nm floor. The RMSF floor was the only dynamic discriminator and white noise cleared it, contradicting this protocol's own negative_diagnostic.

dynamic_discriminators.null_model: a static structure observed with independent per-frame Gaussian coordinate noise
dynamic_discriminators.threshold_derivation: Both thresholds are computed from the ANALYTIC null distribution of the statistic under independent per-frame noise, as a function of the number of production frames N. They are not derived from, and were frozen before, any control-5 or production MD outcome. Because they scale as 1/sqrt(N) they also cannot be relaxed by choosing a run length.

D1_temporal_structure.statistic: lag-1 Pearson autocorrelation of the supported_ge2of3 region CA convex-hull volume time series
D1_temporal_structure.null: for IID frames r1 has mean ~ -1/N and standard deviation ~ 1/sqrt(N)
D1_temporal_structure.rationale: the CA convex-hull volume is a slow collective backbone coordinate and is strongly autocorrelated at the frozen 50 ps output cadence, whereas per-frame coordinate noise has r1 ~ 0

D2_spatial_collectivity.statistic: mean absolute dynamic cross-correlation among supported_ge2of3 region CA atoms
D2_spatial_collectivity.null: for IID frames each off-diagonal correlation is ~N(0, 1/sqrt(N)), so E[|c|] = sqrt(2/pi)/sqrt(N)
D2_spatial_collectivity.rationale: genuine molecular motion displaces spatially adjacent residues collectively; independent per-atom noise does not

dynamic_discriminators.reported_but_not_gating: a matched static-structure-plus-noise surrogate built from each replicate's own frame-0 region coordinates and its own observed RMSF is computed and reported alongside D1/D2 so the null comparison is explicit in the output

control_interpretability_gate.negative_diagnostic: starting structures differ plus tiny random coordinate noise must fail because static separation alone is not dynamic validation

summaries: bootstrap CI across replicates only when n is sufficient

interpretation_categories.supportive: multiple independent candidate trajectories show reproducible predefined opening/accessibility dynamics centered on core/supported region and controls remain interpretable
interpretation_categories.partially_supportive: some predefined behavior appears, but magnitude/frequency/replicate consistency is limited
interpretation_categories.inconclusive: sampling, control behavior, mapping, or variability prevents reliable conclusion
interpretation_categories.weakening: region remains closed/stable under adequate sampling where control demonstrates assay sensitivity
interpretation_categories.contradictory: evidence conflicts with a specific prospective prediction

source_hashes.reconciliation_change_reason: positive-control gate repaired to reject static starting-state differences alone; 2026-08-16 revision replaces the v1 gate, whose only dynamic discriminator (an absolute RMSF floor) was cleared by independent per-frame coordinate noise, with predeclared temporal-structure and spatial-collectivity discriminators referenced to the analytic IID-noise null. No MD outcome informed either threshold: no control-5 or production trajectory existed when this revision was frozen.
source_hashes.revision_permitted_because: the frozen candidate residue sets, reference structures, atom selections, openness thresholds and event definitions are UNCHANGED. Only the control-interpretability gate is revised, and it is revised BEFORE any meaningful control MD exists.
